paragraphs: Many families in Dublin rent their homes from Dublin City Council. In April, the council made these rents higher. Now it says it will look at the new rents again next year.
The rent depends on how much money a family earns. The average rent is now €108 a week. That is €22 more than before. For half of the families, the rent went up by €14 a week or less.
A council officer said the money helps to repair homes. It will bring in €22.5 million this year.
Sinn Féin wants to stop the higher rents. It wants businesses to pay more instead. The council will vote on its budget on Monday.

paragraphs: Dublin City Council has promised to review its new rent system for social housing. Many people want the council to cancel the rent increases in its budget for 2027.

Rents for council tenants went up last April. It was the first big change to the system in 30 years. Rents are based on how much each household earns after tax, so people who earn more pay more. However, almost all tenants are now paying something extra.

The average weekly rent is now €108, which is €22 more than before. For half of all tenants, the rise was €14 a week or less. About 2 per cent of tenants saw their rent go up by more than half. These are usually homes with more than two workers.

Richard Whelan, a senior council officer, said the old system was not fair. Under it, homes with more workers paid a smaller part of their income in rent. He said the new system will raise €22.5 million this year to pay for repairs. He added that the council will review it next year.
Sinn Féin wants councillors to reverse the increases at a budget meeting on Monday. Councillors cannot set rents, but they can vote against the budget.

許多人希望市議會在2027年預算中取消租金調漲。
市議會租戶的租金在去年四月上漲。

租金是依每戶的稅後收入計算，所以賺得多的人付得多。
不過，現在幾乎所有租戶都多付了一些錢。
現在平均週租金是108歐元，比以前多了22歐元。
對一半的租戶來說，漲幅是每週14歐元或更少。
約2%的租戶租金漲了一半以上。
這些通常是有兩個以上工作者的家庭。

在舊制度下，工作者較多的家庭付的租金占收入比例反而較小。
他說新制度今年將籌得2250萬歐元，用來支付修繕費用。

新芬黨希望議員在週一的預算會議上撤回漲價。
議員不能訂定租金，但可以投票反對預算。

paragraphs: Dublin City Council has committed to reviewing its new social housing rent scheme, as pressure mounts on the council to scrap the increases in its 2027 budget.

Rents for council tenants rose last April in the first major overhaul of the system in three decades. The scheme is differential, meaning rents are linked to a household's net income, so higher earners pay more. Even so, tenants at every income level have seen some increase.

According to council figures, the average weekly rent now stands at €108, up €22. Half of all tenancies rose by €14 a week or less, while around 2 per cent faced increases of more than 50 per cent. Those households typically have more than two earners and average net incomes of €1,450 a week.

Richard Whelan, a senior official in the housing division, told the finance committee that the previous scheme created a disparity, because the more earners a household had, the smaller the share of income it paid in rent. He said the new system would raise €22.5 million this year for maintenance, and that the council would review it next year.
Sinn Féin has tabled a motion for Monday's budget meeting to reverse the increases and raise business rates instead. Councillors cannot set rents, but they can refuse to pass the budget.

市議會租戶的租金在去年四月上漲，這是該制度三十年來首次大規模改革。

即便如此，各收入階層的租戶都經歷了一定程度的漲幅。
根據市議會的數據，平均週租金目前為108歐元，上漲了22歐元。
半數租約每週漲14歐元或更少，而約2%的租約漲幅超過50%。
這些家庭通常有兩個以上有收入者，平均每週淨收入為1450歐元。
住房部門資深官員Richard Whelan告訴財務委員會，舊方案造成了不公平的差距，因為一個家庭有收入的人越多，付的租金占收入比例反而越小。
他說新制度今年將為維修籌得2250萬歐元，市議會明年將檢討該制度。
新芬黨已為週一的預算會議提出動議，要求撤回漲租並改為調高商業稅。
議員不能訂定租金，但可以拒絕通過預算。

paragraphs: Dublin City Council has pledged to re-examine its contentious new social housing rent regime, amid mounting calls for the increases to be scrapped in its 2027 budget.

Council tenants saw their rents climb last April in the most sweeping revision of the system in 30 years. Under the differential model, charges are pegged to net household income, so those on higher earnings contribute more, although tenants right across the income spectrum have felt the pinch.

Council data show the average weekly rent has risen by €22 to €108. Half of all tenancies saw rises of €14 a week or less, yet roughly 2 per cent were hit with hikes exceeding 50 per cent. These are predominantly multi-earner households with average net incomes of €1,450 a week.

Richard Whelan, a senior housing official, told the finance committee that the old arrangement had produced an anomaly whereby households with more earners surrendered a smaller proportion of their income in rent. The revised scheme, he said, would generate €22.5 million this year to bankroll maintenance, and would be scrutinised next year.

Sinn Féin has tabled a motion for Monday's budget meeting to reverse the hikes and offset the shortfall through higher business rates. While councillors have no power to set rents, they may withhold approval of the budget, albeit at the risk of being removed by the Minister for Local Government.
sentZh: 在要求於2027年預算中取消漲租的呼聲日益高漲之際，都柏林市議會承諾重新審視其具爭議的社會住宅新租金制度。
市議會租戶的租金在去年四月攀升，這是該制度30年來最全面的修訂。
在差別制模式下，收費與家庭淨收入掛鉤，收入較高者負擔較多，不過各收入層級的租戶都感受到了壓力。
市議會數據顯示，平均週租金上漲22歐元至108歐元。
半數租約每週漲幅在14歐元以內，但約有2%遭遇超過50%的大幅調漲。
這些主要是多人有收入的家庭，平均每週淨收入1450歐元。
資深住房官員Richard Whelan告訴財務委員會，舊安排造成一種反常現象：有收入者越多的家庭，交出的租金占收入比例反而越小。
他說修訂後的方案今年將產生2250萬歐元以資助維修，並將於明年接受仔細審查。
新芬黨已為週一的預算會議提出動議，要求撤回漲租，並以提高商業稅來彌補缺口。
雖然議員無權訂定租金，但他們可以不批准預算，只是要冒著被地方政府部長解職的風險。

paragraphs: Dublin City Council has committed to a formal review of its new social housing rent scheme, as political pressure intensifies to reverse the increases in its 2027 budget.

The scheme, introduced last April, represents the most substantial reform of council rents in three decades. It operates on a differential basis, whereby rents are calculated as a proportion of net household income; consequently, higher earners contribute more, although tenants at all income levels have experienced some increase.

Council figures indicate that the average weekly rent has risen by €22 to €108. While half of all tenancies increased by €14 a week or less, approximately 2 per cent experienced rises in excess of 50 per cent, predominantly households with multiple earners.

Richard Whelan, a senior housing official, argued that the previous system had generated a significant disparity, since households with more earners paid a disproportionately small share of their income in rent. He estimated that the revised scheme would yield €22.5 million this year for maintenance, and indicated that a review would take place next year.

Sinn Féin has nevertheless proposed reversing the increases and compensating for the shortfall through higher business rates. Although councillors lack the authority to set rents, they could refuse to approve the budget, a course of action contingent upon accepting the risk of removal by the Minister.
sentZh: 隨著要求在2027年預算中撤回漲租的政治壓力加劇，都柏林市議會已承諾正式檢討其社會住宅新租金方案。
這項去年四月推出的方案，是三十年來對市議會租金最重大的改革。
它以差別制運作，租金按家庭淨收入的一定比例計算；因此收入較高者負擔較多，不過各收入層級的租戶都經歷了一定漲幅。
市議會數據顯示，平均週租金已上漲22歐元至108歐元。
雖然半數租約每週漲幅在14歐元以內，但約2%的漲幅超過50%，主要是多人有收入的家庭。
資深住房官員Richard Whelan主張，舊制度造成了顯著的落差，因為有收入者較多的家庭所付租金占收入的比例低得不成比例。
他估計修訂後的方案今年將為維修帶來2250萬歐元，並表示明年將進行檢討。
然而，新芬黨仍提議撤回漲租，並以提高商業稅來彌補缺口。
雖然議員沒有訂定租金的權力，但他們可以拒絕批准預算，而採取此舉的前提是願意承擔被部長解職的風險。
